description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAppCache component in the Apache OFBiz framework, focusing on verifying the correct behavior of web app info retrieval, filtering, memoization, and configuration handling.

classes.name: WebAppCacheTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the WebAppCache functionality, including retrieval, filtering, memoization, and handling of WebappInfo instances in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a list of ComponentConfig objects and a WebAppCache instance, and setting up WebappInfo list for testing.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosBasic
methods.description: Tests that getAppBarWebInfos retrieves the correct WebappInfo objects based on server name.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosBasicWithMenu
methods.description: Tests retrieval of WebappInfo objects filtered by server name and menu name.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosMemoization
methods.description: Verifies that once getAppBarWebInfos is called, subsequent modifications to the source do not affect cached results.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosSamePosition
methods.description: Checks handling of WebappInfo instances with the same position, ensuring proper ordering and retrieval.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosSameTitle
methods.description: Verifies that multiple WebappInfo instances with identical titles are both retrieved.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosPositionTitle
methods.description: Tests behavior when WebappInfo instances have explicit positions, ensuring no unintended collision.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosDisplayFalse
methods.description: Ensures that WebappInfo objects with appBarDisplay set to false are properly ignored or included based on context.

methods.name: getWebappInfoBasic
methods.description: Tests retrieval of WebappInfo based on server and mount point, including handling of non-existent entries.
